 THIS MFA, COMING ON FOR ADMISSION, THIS DAY,
JUDGMENT WAS DELIVERED THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE H.T.NARENDRA PRASAD  AND  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE TYAGARAJA N. INAVALLY  ORAL JUDGMENT (PER: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE H.T.NARENDRA PRASAD)

This appeal is filed by the legal representatives of deceased injured claimant challenging the judgment and award dated 19.09.2023 passed by the Principal Senior Civil Judge and MACT-V, Vijayapur in MVC No.562/2020.

2. Learned counsel appearing for the appellants contented that the claimant-Babaji S/o Bhagappa Agasar NC: 2025:KHC-K:7483-DB HC-KAR was injured in a road traffic accident occurred on 02.02.2020 due to rash and negligent driving of the driver of vehicle bearing Reg.No.KA-28/C-5844.
During the pendency of the claim petition, the claimant has died.
His legal representatives have come on record.
The Tribunal has dismissed the claim petition only on the ground that the legal representatives cannot prosecute the claim petition presented by the injured.

He contended that in view of Supreme Court judgment in the case of Oriental Insurance Company Limited vs. Kahlon@Jasmail Singh Kahlon and Another [Livelaw 2021 SC 382], the claim petition is Babaji S/O Bhagappa Agasar Since ... vs Kirankumar And Anr on 4 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/109056737/
3 maintainable.

entities.text: Oriental Insurance Company Limited vs. Kahlon@Jasmail Singh Kahlon and Another [Livelaw 2021 SC 382]
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Paragraph-18 is relevant and the same is extracted as under:
"18.
The Tribunal, on technicalities rejected his claim for salary, medical expenses and percentage of disability and granted a measly compensation of Rupees one lakh only by a cryptic order.

We are, therefore, of the opinion that while the claim for personal injuries may not have survived after the death of the injured unrelated to the accident or injuries, during the NC: 2025:KHC-K:7483-DB HC-KAR pendency of the appeal, but the claims for loss of estate caused was available to and could be pursued by the legal representatives of the deceased in the appeal."
3.
The learned counsel appearing for the respondent No.2-Insurance Company has not disputed the legal position.

4. In view of the above, the following order is passed:
ORDER i.
The appeal is allowed.
ii. The impugned judgment and award dated 19.09.2023 passed by the Principal Senior Civil Judge and MACT-V, Vijayapur in MVC No.562/2020 is set aside.
